# ADB GUI Next v0.2.5

## Downloads

Recommended:

- Windows x64: `ADB-GUI-Next-v0.2.5-windows-x86_64-setup.exe`
- Linux x64 Debian/Ubuntu: `ADB-GUI-Next-v0.2.5-linux-x86_64.deb`
- Linux x64 RPM: `ADB-GUI-Next-v0.2.5-linux-x86_64.rpm`
- Linux x64 AppImage: `ADB-GUI-Next-v0.2.5-linux-x86_64.AppImage`

Also available:

- Windows x64 MSI / portable (`…-windows-x86_64-…`)
- Windows i686: NSIS + MSI + portable
- Windows aarch64: NSIS + portable (bundled tools are PE x86 — need OS x86/WOW64 emulation)
- Linux aarch64: deb / rpm / AppImage (**system PATH** adb/fastboot; no bundled platform-tools)

Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to verify downloads.

## Platform support

| Platform | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x86_64 | First-class |
| Windows i686 | Shipped |
| Windows aarch64 | Shipped (NSIS; tools via x86 emulation) |
| Linux x86_64 | First-class (deb, rpm, AppImage) |
| Linux aarch64 | Shipped (PATH tools) |
| macOS | **Builds paused** (code may exist; not a default release target) |

## Notes

- **Not code-signed.** Windows SmartScreen may warn; that is expected.
- App id: `com.astrixforge.adbguinext`. Display name: **ADB GUI Next**.
- Portable zip: extract to a **local** folder (avoid OneDrive cloud-only files), then run `ADB GUI Next.exe`.
- Bundled Windows `adb.exe` is often **32-bit x86** (Google platform-tools); that is normal on 64-bit Windows (WOW64).
- Installers embed the WebView2 bootstrapper; portable builds still need WebView2 Runtime installed.
- ADB and fastboot are bundled on Windows x86_64/i686 and Linux x86_64. Linux aarch64 uses host tools.
- Some advanced workflows need a real device, fastboot/recovery mode, or a host Android SDK for emulators.
- Release bump: update `package.json` then `bun run version:sync` (Cargo.toml).
